lines.text: It doesn't happen on one day, but there is a day you notice it. New rooflines. Glass in windows that held shutters. Scaffolds on buildings nobody thought to change before.
The Library grows a second floor, then a lecture hall. Students argue on its steps at midday. Above the old door a mason cuts a new word into the stone: University.
I used to know every book in that building. Now I don't even know every teacher.
The ledger hurt for it. It holds classes now. Good trade.
The whole town looks different from the hill.
It does. The age has turned.
